From: Claire Miller <claire.miller@searchlightinsights.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: Sun, 3 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPIA support / Article 30 entries request — Searchlight onboarding

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As part of our procurement and legal review we need a short package to populate our DPIA and Article 30 register. Specifically the legal team asked for:

- Completed DPIA questionnaire (we attached our standard template)
- A populated Article 30 CSV extract with processing purposes and subprocessors
- A recent access log sample (redacted OK) covering the past 30 days
- Evidence of KMS / key wrap and subprocessor contracts (high level is fine to start)

Could you confirm whether Redwood can provide these artifacts and whether an onsite (or recorded) DPIA walk-through is possible next week? We have an auditor window the week of Aug 18 and would like to finalize the packet before that.

I've attached our questionnaire to this email. Let me know if you need clarifications on any field.

Thanks,
Claire Miller
Head of Security & Privacy
Searchlight Insights

Appreciate the clear list and the questionnaire. We can absolutely provide the artifacts you've asked for; thanks for flagging the auditor window. Proposed plan:

2) Karthik will prepare the Article 30 CSV extract and a short narrative on subprocessors and legal bases.
3) We'll include a redacted access-log sample and KMS summary; if you need raw logs we can arrange SFTP access under an NDA.
4) Offer: 30-minute DPIA walk-through (recorded) the week of Aug 11, or an onsite review Aug 18 if you need in-person sign-off.

Karthik / Marissa — can you please pick this up for the artifacts listed below? I'm attaching a small template for the Article 30 extract to speed things up.

Claire — I'll share a Drive folder with a scoped set of documents and a pre-filled Article 30 CSV. If anything in the questionnaire needs a technical appendix (e.g., tokenization approach for logs, retention enforcement), flag it and we'll add a short note.

Ben / Marissa — picking this up. Quick scope/ask list I recommend we include in the packet (short, audit-friendly):

- Article 30 CSV (columns: ProcessingActivityID, Purpose, CategoriesOfData, DataSubjects, LegalBasis, Subprocessors, RetentionPeriod) — see attached template.
- DPIA questionnaire: prefilled answers + 1-page technical appendix covering model hosting, inference lifecycle, and telemetry retention.
- Subprocessor roster (current + last 12 months) with role, country, and SCC/transfer mechanism where applicable.
- KMS/key-wrap summary + pointer to our HSM/KMS provider docs (redacted key ids ok).
- Access-log sample (redacted) showing principal, action, timestamp; include a short note on log retention/archival.
- SOC 2 Type II quote and link to report (we can provide an encrypted excerpt for the auditor).

I attached the Article30 template and a small CSV with example rows that match the schema Claire requested. I'll generate the actual extract for Searchlight using the account mapping and include a short plain-language summary for each row.

If Searchlight will accept a recorded walk-through, we can do the recording Aug 11–13 and get the packet in before their audit window. Otherwise, propose Aug 18 for onsite.

Thanks — I'll drop the three files to Ben's Drive folder by EOD Monday.

Karthik
Staff Product Manager, Privacy & Compliance
karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com
